# One ticket. Every path. See what DoorDash actually leaves you.

> Free restaurant delivery fee calculator: put one ticket through dine-in, pickup, DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub. See net after commission, packaging, and extra labor — plus the menu price each app needs to match dine-in.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
